subject: Orphaned line items & commit reconciliation
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orphaned line items & commit reconciliation

Team,

Finance flagged a handful of open opportunities where ARR/amounts are populated but the Product/SKU field is blank or the next step is missing. These are creating noise in our June commit view and inflating probability-weighted ARR. I pulled a quick export and attached the rows flagged as "orphaned" for review.

Top-level ask: can we triage these items by EOD MON (6/4) with the following outcomes per row:
- Confirm product/SKU or map to closest SKU in BrightWave product map
- Update amount if changed or enter "TBD" and add a note in the CRM next-step field
- Adjust probability to reflect current sales stage (if stalled, move to 25% or 0% depending on customer feedback)

I've marked a few rows that look like they might be renewals rather than net-new. Please prioritize deals over $25k ARR.

Attachment: orphaned_lines_export.csv (text/csv)

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@brightwave.ai>, BrightWave Accounts <accounts@brightwave.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fw: Orphaned line items & commit reconciliation

Jordan — looping you in with a small export showing lines on the BrightWave opportunity where the SKU or next-step is blank. If you can confirm which product each line maps to (or mark as invoice/maintenance only) and confirm the committed amount for June, that will help us finalize the month.

We included the BrightWave product map for reference.

Attachment: orphaned_lines_export.csv (text/csv)
Attachment: BrightWave_product_map.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

- Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@brightwave.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightWave Accounts <accounts@brightwave.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 14:35:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fw: Orphaned line items & commit reconciliation

Ben — thanks for the heads up. I pulled our internal PO and confirmed the following:
- OPPTY BW-198: two lines are legacy add-ons (map to SKU: BW-ADD-01). Amounts are correct.
- OPPTY BW-214: this was flagged as $18,000 but it was invoiced as a one-time training seat; we should move that to one-time revenue and set probability to 100% for closed/invoiced.
- OPPTY BW-221: customer asks for more time; lost confidence in delivery window. Please move to 25% and set next step to "Re-engage after Q3 roadmap publication".

I attached a short note from our procurement team for OPPTY BW-221. Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the export.

Jordan Ellis
VP, Revenue Operations
BrightWave
Attachment: BW_OPPTY_221_procurement_note.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Orphaned line items & commit reconciliation

Thanks Jordan — good clarity. Team, based on Jordan's notes I recommend the following CRM changes (I can push these if you assign me rows in the export):
- Map BW-198 lines to BW-ADD-01, leave amount, set probability to 90% (renewal-type confidence).
- Move BW-214 to "One-time revenue" product type, set closed date to May 29, 2028, probability 100%, add invoice ref in notes.
- For BW-221 update next step and probability to 25%, leave amount but add red flag tag for follow-up in Q3.

I'll also run a quick rule to flag other deals with amount>0 and SKU blank to a separate queue so we can avoid surprises in the last commit refresh.

Marcus Lin
Manager, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@brightwave.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Orphaned line items & commit reconciliation — action log

Appreciate the quick responses. Final action items and owners: 
- Marcus: run the queue rule and make the three CRM updates listed above (BW-198, BW-214, BW-221) by COB MON (6/4).
- Laura: audit deals >= $25k in the attached export for correct next-step text and add "commit_reviewed_by" tag with your initials.
- Ben: follow up with BrightWave procurement on any outstanding PO gaps and confirm any amount changes; copy Hannah on updates.

I'll push a small reconciliation report to HubSpot once the updates are live so Finance can re-run the commit view. If anyone hits blockers, escalate to me directly.

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
